Item.Name: S_CTRL_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter all or part of service code.

Item.Name: S_CTRL_DESC
Item.Hint: Enter part of the service code description for search.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
Begin
 go_block('VSERV_BILLING_CODES');
 :system.message_level:= 5;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if :billing_code is null
 then
 message('Msg: No records to retrieve.');
 end if;
end;

Block.Name: VSERV_BILLING_CODES
Block.WhereClause: where upper(billing_code) like '%'||upper(:s_ctrl_code)||'%' and upper(code_desc) like '%'||upper(:s_ctrl_desc)||'%'

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
Begin
select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x from vserv_billing_codes where
billing_code=:billing_code;
message('Err : This code already exists.');
raise form_trigger_failure;
exception
when no_data_found then
 null;
end;

Item.Name: EFF_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter effective date in DD-MON-YYYY format.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_date date;
 v_local_time date;

begin
 nullchk;
 --
 -- Check that effective date is >= today
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED')
 then
 if trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(v_local_date)
 then
 show_error_dist ('0501');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif trunc(:eff_date) > trunc(:term_date)
 then
 show_error_dist('0507');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if trunc(:term_date) < trunc(:eff_date) and
 :term_date is not null
 then
 next_item;
 show_error_dist ('0507');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if trunc(:term_date) < trunc(:eff_date) and
 :term_date is not null
 then
 show_error_dist ('0507');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_date date;
 v_local_time date;
Begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 :vserv_billing_codes.last_modified_date:=v_local_date ;
 :vserv_billing_codes.program_id:=:banner.prog_name;
 commit;
end;
